sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Activates the "Smugglers' Boat" and "Smugglers' Bunker (ZB-1012)" extractions on Customs.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: - The word "voron" stands for "raven" in Russian, which is possibly a codename for a smuggler.
